page.layout: One page of text in a decorative border; no margin notes. Running head at top; page number 220 at top left. Below the text block there is no further text. A partly visible facing page at the far right edge is show-through/edge and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: dam perpessa, omnibus obvia, paucissimis cognita, Qua inse habet, quacunq; ad totius operis complementum sunt ei necessaria, omnia motu extrinseco.

13. Est autem Natura haec quaedam media inter Majorem & Minorem Mundum ubiq; repertitia, & tam ad pauperē, quàm ad divitem uti adserunt omnes Philosophi. Proficitur enim in viis, & conculcatur pedibus: licet tam admirandarum operationum sit fons. Unde tria illa corporis principia, sunt instauranda.
14. Haec materia resoluta in suam propriam Aquam (ab Aquâ enim omnis Generatio profluit) per 4. Elementa rotatur, donec in Naturam Astralem fixam abeat, in Ovo Physico, quod à fotu Gallina indesi-

page.notes: Running head and heading set in large capitals; the text is in italic (Latin with some underlined words). The text at line ends is hyphenated and continues on the next line where the page breaks (indesi-). Some words are underlined and show printed marks such as "ubiq;" and "Proficitur"; "Proficitur" and "invis" readings are uncertain: the first line reads "Pro-/yciturenim in uys" and is transcribed as printed in the scan, with doubtful letters in "in uiis" possibly [?]. The printed text in the bottom border is not text. The left-hand facing page is blank.
